item.title: Daily Minute — November 27, 2026
item.description:

item.title: Lesson 144: “My mind holds only what I think with God.”
item.description: “My mind holds only what I think with God.” [127] “There is no love but God’s.” [128] “The world I see has nothing that I want.”
